note: Planted issues standing in for historical customer feedback. Agents never see this file.

issues.title: Team invitations hard to find
issues.description: Inviting a teammate is under Settings > Workspace Administration > Seats & Provisioning, using jargon ('provision seat', 'principal identifier', 'entitlement') instead of 'Team', 'Invite', 'Email', 'Role'.

issues.title: Onboarding blocks on accounting integration
issues.description: Onboarding step 2 requires connecting QuickBooks/Xero/NetSuite; connections fail with a technical error and the only way past is a tiny, low-contrast 'remind me later' link.

issues.title: Expense form: unexplained date format and unhelpful errors
issues.description: The date field silently requires DD/MM/YYYY; any validation failure shows only 'Invalid input. Please try again.' and wipes every field.

issues.title: Unexplained required cost center code
issues.description: Expense form requires a 'Cost center code' (format CC-####) with no explanation, example, or way to look one up.

issues.title: Pricing not discoverable inside the app
issues.description: No pricing in navigation; Billing shows only 'Trial' and 'Manage subscription' says to contact an account representative. Plans are only reachable via a tiny footer link.

issues.title: Hidden pricing conditions
issues.description: Growth plan's $12/user price has fine print: billed annually, minimum 10 seats; Scale is 'Contact sales'. Small teams can't tell what they'd actually pay.

issues.title: No approval workflow or approval rules
issues.description: Expenses are auto-approved; there is no way to set approval rules, approvers, or spending policies.

issues.title: No bulk actions on expenses
issues.description: Expense list has no multi-select or bulk approve/categorize/edit.

issues.title: CSV export doesn't work
issues.description: 'Export CSV' button leads to a 'coming soon' page.

issues.title: No audit log
issues.description: There is no audit trail/activity log for compliance-minded finance users.
